name: stager_linux
author: jm33-ng
comment: A Linux stager with modular payload transports (http, tcp, udp, and library-backed ones such as libcurl and libssl) and RC4 obfuscation. Use with emp3r0r-listener

parameters.name: stager-format
parameters.description: Stager can be generated as shared library (.so), ELF executable, raw shellcode (.bin), or self-unpacking packed shellcode (.bin)

parameters.name: transport
parameters.description: Transport used to download the payload. Built-in: http, tcp, udp. Runtime-library transports: libcurl, libssl (HTTPS with a malleable HTTP profile). Custom transports can be added as transport_<name>.c

parameters.name: download-host
parameters.description: The host to download the payload from, eg. 192.168.0.1

parameters.name: download-port
parameters.description: The port to download the payload from, eg. 8000

parameters.name: download-path
parameters.description: The path to download the payload from (http transports only), eg. /payload

parameters.name: download-key
parameters.description: The key to decrypt the payload

parameters.name: unpacker
parameters.description: Packing algorithm used for the self-unpacking packed format (rc4: encrypted, lzss: compressed)

parameters.name: dynload-mode
parameters.description: Which dl* symbols to resolve from libc at runtime: 'public' (dlopen/dlsym/dlclose, glibc >= 2.34) or 'libc_dl' (glibc-internal __libc_dlopen_mode/__libc_dlsym/__libc_dlclose for older glibc)

parameters.name: hash-style
parameters.description: Dynamic symbol hash table to use: 'auto' (DT_HASH then DT_GNU_HASH), 'sysv' (DT_HASH only), or 'gnu' (DT_GNU_HASH only)

parameters.name: ech
parameters.description: Enable Encrypted Client Hello (ECH) for the libssl transport. Requires OpenSSL 4.0+ on the target and an ECH-capable front (eg. Cloudflare); falls back to normal TLS when unsupported. Ignored by other transports

parameters.name: ech-config
parameters.description: Base64 ECHConfigList from the front domain's DNS HTTPS RR (used when ech=on): dig +short HTTPS cdn.example.com, take the value after 'ech='

parameters.name: supervise
parameters.description: Run the agent PIC in a sacrificial child process and cache its ephemeral identity key pair across restarts: the parent kills and restarts the child, so the agent's memory is fully reclaimed while the C2's pinned TOFU identity survives. Requires an agent built with --stager

parameters.name: supervise-sleep-min
parameters.description: Minimum seconds the supervisor sleeps before restarting the agent (only used when supervise=on)

parameters.name: supervise-sleep-max
parameters.description: Maximum seconds the supervisor sleeps before restarting the agent (only used when supervise=on)
